summary: Codex successfully implemented Phase 1: Shared Design Foundation & Player Hero HUD Overhaul. The right sidebar #stats panel has been completely transformed from legacy inline floats and raw text into a bespoke, high-contrast dark-fantasy RPG Hero Status Interface. The Hero Crest displays the dynamic character doll avatar, species/background calling, and deity affiliation with live piety stars. Vigour & Arcane meters feature smooth animations, color-coded health states, danger warning pulses, and accurate poison survival previews. The Attribute Deck presents grouped, framed cards for STR/INT/DEX, AC/EV/SH, XL progress, and Noise levels with explanatory tooltips. The Armament Dock displays equipped weapons, offhand items, and quiver ammo with authentic sprites, enchantment pluses, and brand badges, strictly respecting item identification. All 5 Hero HUD Node test suites, 22 examination card tests, 9 floating event tests, and 24 .ai-team Python tests passed completely, with full live browser gameplay verification.

findings.notes: Renders character doll sprite canvas directly in `#hero_portrait` using `DungeonCellRenderer`. Formats player title, species/background calling (e.g. 'Minotaur Berserker'), and deity affiliation with 6-star piety rating ('Trog ★☆☆☆☆☆'). Safely handles penance, Gozag gold, and atheist characters.

Animated HP/MP gauges with tabular numeric readouts ('19 / 19 HP', '0 / 0 MP'). Dynamic color shifts: vibrant emerald (>60%), amber (30-60%), crimson (<30%) with danger pulse animation. Accurately renders projected poison survival bar when `poison_survival` is available. Respects `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` by disabling transitions.

findings.component: Dark Fantasy Attribute Deck (game.html, player.js, style.css)
findings.notes: Replaced messy inline floats with structured `.er-stat-card` grids: Primary Attributes (STR, INT, DEX), Combat Defenses (AC, EV, SH), Progression (XL, XP progress, Noise meter), and Location/Time/Gold. Includes hover tooltips explaining core combat mechanics.

Displays Main Weapon, Offhand, and Quiver slots with item sprites, inventory letter badges, enchantment pluses, and ego chips. Strictly respects item identification: un-identified items conceal curses, enchantments, and brands. Clicking weapon slot invokes legitimate `inv_item_describe` inspection modal.
Active conditions render as color-coded badges (beneficial, warning, danger) with existing engine status descriptions in tooltips. Does not reveal hidden durations.

5/5 Hero HUD test suites passed in `hero_hud_test.js`, 22/22 examination card tests passed, 9/9 floating events tests passed, 24/24 `.ai-team` tests passed. C++ binary recompiled cleanly under GCC 13.3 in WSL Ubuntu.

Verified in Chromium at `http://localhost:8088`. Tested Minotaur Berserker: verified avatar doll, Trog piety stars, HP gauge, attribute deck, weapon sprite + hotkey badge, floating world feedback, and weapon modal inspection. Zero layout collisions or clipping across 1920x1080 down to mobile viewports.

recommendations: Commit review record, push feature/webtiles-hero-hud to origin, and open Pull Request for user approval before moving to Phase 2.
